claims.value: Plan for up to 2,200 homes would cover 81% of Brisbane's state-mandated housing allocation

claims.note: General Plan amendments, Baylands Specific Plan, rezoning to BSP, Final EIR SCH# 2006022136

construction_notes.text: Specific plan: 2,200 residential units clustered in the northwestern portion of the site; 6.5 million sq ft of commercial, office, retail, conference, life science, and office campus uses; 500,000 sq ft of hotel (about 800 rooms); grade 6-8 middle school; 157 acres of open space, parks, and trails
Former landfill and rail yard site; remedial action plans approved 2021, landfill closure plan approved February 2025
City Council hearing dates listed from September 14 through December 7, 2026, the later ones tentative.

events.label: Universal Paragon Corp. applies for a commercial development on the site (no housing)
Voters approve Measure JJ, amending the General Plan for the Baylands (1,800 to 2,200 units)
Developer's 2025 draft Specific Plan and Draft EIR released
Final EIR and staff-recommended Specific Plan released
State deadline to adopt the Specific Plan passes; HCD temporarily decertifies the Housing Element
State rules Brisbane out of compliance with housing law; builder's remedy applies citywide until compliance
Planning Commission votes 5-0 to recommend certifying the Final EIR and adopting the Specific Plan with modifications
City Council begins Baylands public hearings (continued through fall 2026)
